mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job_application WHERE job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM job_application WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM job_application WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_application (job_id, student_id, merchant_id, student_name, time_availability, credit_score, application_content, selected_dates, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{studentId}, #{merchantId}, #{studentName}, #{timeAvailability, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{creditScore}, #{applicationContent}, #{selectedDates, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'pending', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM job_application WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = #{status}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_application WHERE job_id = #{jobId} AND status = 'accepted'
mapper.update: UPDATE job_application SET status = #{status}, time_availability = #{timeAvailability, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, application_content = #{applicationContent}, selected_dates = #{selectedDates, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
